mainEntity.name: What return on investment (ROI) can I expect from a kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen renovation is one of the most effective home improvements for increasing property value. While ROI can vary based on market conditions, location, and the quality of the renovation, homeowners typically see a strong return. Mid-range kitchen remodels often recoup around 60-70% of their cost at resale, while minor cosmetic updates might return even more, sometimes up to 80%. High-end, luxury renovations may have a slightly lower percentage return but significantly enhance desirability. Beyond financial returns, a renovated kitchen greatly improves daily living and enjoyment of your home.
